entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  distance to EMA20 = +4.71% -> -28 (weight 1.8) - Price 103.50 vs EMA20 98.84
  Bollinger position = 64% of band -> -22 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  resistance proximity = 39.9% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI 1h = 48.7 -> +8 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI daily = 62.2 -> -9 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone
  MACD divergence (1h) = hidden bearish -> -8 (weight 1.3) - strength 23/100

  weighted sum / total weight (8.5) = -6.8 -> WAIT
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
